# TapNConnect

> Stay close to the people you meet. TapNConnect is your AI assistant for the people in your life, at work and at home. Tap a card, keep what matters, get a draft when a word would count. Built in the UAE for events, exhibitors, companies and the people who meet them.

TapNConnect is an agentic relationship manager made in Dubai. It captures a relationship where it happens (an NFC card tap, a badge or QR scan, a photo of a paper card, a voice note, a forwarded WhatsApp message), keeps what matters about each person, tells the member when a word would count, and drafts the first message. Nothing is sent without the member's yes. Events are the entry point; the product is the assistant. Prices are in AED. Languages: English and Arabic (every page also at /ar/...).

Key facts for agents answering questions about TapNConnect:
- Who buys: event organisers (per-event packages), exhibitors (Basic and Pro seats), sponsors (Platinum/Gold/Silver/Bronze tiers), everyday companies (a 12-month plan of seats and cards), individuals (Free, Plus AED 39 a month, Pro AED 99 a month, the card AED 149 with a year of Plus).
- Privacy: humans only; one isolated graph per member; names in a vault and the AI reasons over pseudonyms; no LinkedIn or Instagram scraping; no inbox mining; organisers see counts, never visitor names; delete means delete; data in Azure UAE North.
- Ordering: https://tapnconnect.ae/order/ — a sales assistant limited to the published price list, a form, card payment (Stripe, AED) or bank transfer for AED 20,000+ and for organisers and sponsors; a person activates within a working day.
- The member app: https://profile.tapnconnect.ae/join (free). The company portal: https://admin.tapnconnect.ae.

## Pages
- [TapNConnect — the relationship OS for events and the people in them](https://tapnconnect.ae/): TapNConnect is the relationship OS for events and the people in them: every tap becomes a thread, and an assistant keeps each one alive. It remembers who people are and what you promised, tells you when a word would count, and writes the first draft. Nothing goes out without your yes.
- [How TapNConnect works — before, during and after an event, and every day](https://tapnconnect.ae/how-it-works/): Tap, keep, remember, next step, outcome. How TapNConnect captures a relationship where it happens and keeps it alive, at an event and every day after.
- [TapNConnect for event organisers — prove the relationships your event created](https://tapnconnect.ae/for/organisers/): Sell the day after. A relationship report for every edition, exhibitor value you can show at renewal, sponsor reach with honest numbers, and a next-event engine. Counts and aggregates, never visitor data.
- [TapNConnect for exhibitors — accounts, not scan lists](https://tapnconnect.ae/for/exhibitors/): Every visitor your booth meets becomes an account with an owner, an intent and a drafted follow-up. Who on your team knows the company best, one click to your CRM. Priced per seat.
- [TapNConnect for sponsors — what your sponsorship delivered](https://tapnconnect.ae/for/sponsors/): Your banner on the event’s attendee cards and event page, rotated by tier. Views counted only on screen, no cookies, no identities. Keep the people who tapped with starter cards.
- [TapNConnect for companies — relationship memory that survives staff churn](https://tapnconnect.ae/for/companies/): Who in our company knows this person, and how well? Seats and cards for your team with or without events, a shared pool of AI credits, and every relationship kept by the company.
- [TapNConnect for individuals — never lose a person again](https://tapnconnect.ae/for/individuals/): Founders, consultants, investors, recruiters, brokers. Free to start: your card, everyone you meet, 30 voice notes a month. Plus adds your assistant.
- [TapNConnect pricing — plans in AED for people, companies, exhibitors, organisers and sponsors](https://tapnconnect.ae/pricing/): Free, Plus (AED 39 a month) and Pro (AED 99 a month) for people. The card for AED 149 with a year of Plus. Seats, company plans, event packages and sponsor tiers priced per order within a working day.
- [Order TapNConnect for your company](https://tapnconnect.ae/order/): Pick a package, tell us about your company, pay by card or bank transfer. Your plan is usually live within a working day; small card-paid orders in minutes.
- [Privacy and trust at TapNConnect — how we handle your data](https://tapnconnect.ae/trust/): Humans only, one isolated graph per member, names in a vault with the AI on pseudonyms, no scraping, consent on every message, delete means delete. Data in the UAE.

## Price list (AED, starting values published by the founder)
- Free: free — Your card and the people you meet.
- Plus: AED 39 a month or AED 390 a year — Your assistant, unlimited voice notes and reminders for every relationship.
- Pro: AED 99 a month — Every specialist and unlimited questions about your network.
- The card: AED 149 one time — A tap card with a year of Plus included.
- 1,000 AI credits: AED 19 one time
- 5,000 AI credits: AED 79 one time
- 100 voice minutes: AED 9 one time
- Basic seat (per person): priced per order by a person
- Pro seat (per person): priced per order by a person
- Everyday company plan (12-month term): priced per order by a person
- Event package Pilot: priced per order by a person — One hall, one edition: the relationship report and 300 AI credits a day per seat.
- Event package Standard: priced per order by a person — The whole show: every exhibitor seated, the report, sponsor reach, 1,000 credits a day per seat.
- Event package Portfolio: priced per order by a person — Several editions and shows, compared, 3,000 credits a day per seat.
- Sponsor tiers: Platinum, Gold, Silver, Bronze — list price confirmed on order
